title: Analysis of glycosphingolipids from human plasma
author: David A Priestman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.busvnwe6
materials: Use 50 µL plasma for GSL quantification.
Allow to cool to Room temperature .
Pre-equilibrate 50 mg Discovery® DPA-6S SPE Tube (supplied by Sigma-Aldrich) with: 1 mL acetonitrile 2 x 1 mL water 2 x 1 mL acetonitrile
1.0 mg/ml 100 µL Matreya Ganglioside mix Cat No 1510 (Lac-Cer, GM3, GD
0.5 mg/ml 100 µL Matreya Ganglioside mix Cat No 1511 (GA1, GM1a, GD1a, GD1b,GT1b) 0.5 mg/ml 30 µL Matreya GM2 Ganglioside Cat No 1502 (GM
0.5 mg/ml 30 µL Sigma Asialo-GM2 Cat No G9398 (GA

steps.title: Adjust plasma volume to 200 µL
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL de‑ionised water to the plasma sample in a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube to bring the total volume to 200 µL.

steps.title: Add chloroform/methanol (1:2)
steps.instruction: Add 0.8 mL chloroform/methanol (1:2, v/v) to achieve a final solvent ratio of chloroform : methanol : water = 4 : 8 : 3.

steps.title: Vortex sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube to mix the solvents thoroughly.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 10 min (00:10:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant and add PBS/chloroform
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 1 mL supernatant to a new tube, then add 0.2 mL PBS followed by 0.2 mL chloroform to create two phases.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~1 mL supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Vortex phase mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube to mix the aqueous and organic phases.

steps.title: Centrifuge second time
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect lower organic phase
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the lower (organic) phase to a new tube and retain the upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: Dry lower phase under nitrogen
steps.instruction: Evaporate the lower phase under a stream of oxygen‑free nitrogen in a heating block set to 42 °C until completely dry.

steps.title: Re‑suspend lower phase
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried lower phase in 20 µL chloroform/methanol (1:3).

steps.title: Combine phases and vortex
steps.instruction: Add the retained upper phase to the re‑suspended lower phase and vortex.

steps.title: Pre‑equilibrate C18 column
steps.instruction: Pre‑equilibrate a Telos C18 column (Kinesis, UK) with four 1 mL washes of methanol followed by three 1 mL washes of de‑ionised water.

steps.title: Load sample onto C18
steps.instruction: Load the combined phase mixture onto the C18 column and allow it to drip through by gravity flow.

steps.title: Rinse tube and wash column
steps.instruction: Rinse the original sample tube with 1 mL water and apply the rinse to the column for washing.

steps.title: Wash column with water
steps.instruction: Wash the column with three successive 1 mL aliquots of water.

steps.title: Elute GSLs with C/M (98:2)
steps.instruction: Elute glycoconjugates with 2 mL chloroform/methanol (98:2); first push 0.5 mL through the column using a syringe adapter, then add the remaining 1.5 mL.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL chloroform/methanol (98:2) to the column.
Push the first 0.5 mL through with a syringe adapter.
Allow the remaining 1.5 mL to flow through.

steps.title: Incubate eluate overnight
steps.instruction: Vortex the eluate and store overnight at 4 °C, or proceed directly to enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Vortex and dry eluate
steps.instruction: Vortex the eluate (approximately 5 mL) and dry under a nitrogen stream in a heating block set to 42 °C.

steps.title: Transfer to 1.5 mL tube
steps.instruction: When about 150 µL remains, transfer the residue to a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Rinse tube with C:M 2:1
steps.instruction: Rinse the tube with 200 µL chloroform:methanol (2:1), vortex, and combine the rinse with the sample in the tube.

steps.title: Dry sample under nitrogen
steps.instruction: Dry the combined sample under a slow stream of nitrogen in a 42 °C heating block.

steps.title: Re‑suspend and final dry
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried residue in 50 µL chloroform:methanol (2:1), vortex, then dry under a very slow nitrogen stream ensuring all liquid is removed from the tube bottom.

steps.title: Add rEGCase enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 90 µL enzyme/buffer to each sample: 4 µL recombinant Endoglycoceramidase I (rEGCase) plus 86 µL buffer (0.6 % Triton in 50 mM sodium acetate, pH 5.2, stored at 4 °C). Vortex.

steps.title: Digest at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 16 h (16:00:00).

steps.title: Prepare 2AA labeling mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a labeling mix containing 30 mg/mL 2‑aminobenzoic acid (2AA) in labelling buffer (4 % sodium acetate, 2 % boric acid in methanol) and 45 mg/mL sodium cyanoborohydride. First dissolve 2AA in the buffer with vortexing, then add sodium cyanoborohydride and vortex (handle cyanoborohydride with care).

steps.title: Add labeling mix
steps.instruction: Add 310 µL of the labeling mix to the 90 µL enzyme digest in the 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Incubate labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in an oven at 80 °C for 1 h (01:00:00), vortexing briefly at the 30‑minute mark (00:30:00).

steps.title: Add acetonitrile‑water
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL acetonitrile:water (97:3) to the reaction mixture.

steps.title: Transfer to 15 mL tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the contents from the screw‑cap tube to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Rinse tube and combine
steps.instruction: Rinse the screw‑cap tube twice with 1 mL acetonitrile:water (97:3) each and add both rinses to the 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Load onto DPA‑6S column
steps.instruction: Apply the total ~3.4 mL sample to an equilibrated DPA‑6S solid‑phase column, allowing gravity flow.

steps.title: Wash DPA‑6S column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 1 mL acetonitrile:water (95:5) collected in the 15 mL tube, then add three successive 1 mL washes of acetonitrile:water (95:5) directly onto the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL acetonitrile:water (95:5) and collect flow‑through.

steps.title: Elute glycans with water
steps.instruction: Elute the bound glycans with 600 µL water into a new tube.

steps.title: Aliquot to HPLC vials
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of the sample and 140 µL acetonitrile (sample:acetonitrile 60:140) to HPLC vials and vortex.

steps.title: Prepare GSL standard mix
steps.instruction: In a screw‑cap tube combine: 50 µL Matreya Neutral GSL mix (1.0 mg/mL), 100 µL Matreya Ganglioside mix 1 (0.5 mg/mL), 100 µL Matreya Ganglioside mix 2 (0.5 mg/mL), 30 µL Matreya GM2 (0.5 mg/mL), and 30 µL Sigma Asialo‑GM2 (1.0 mg/mL). Dry under nitrogen and then process through the same digestion, labeling, and cleanup steps as the plasma samples (steps 25‑41).

steps.title: Inject calibration standard
steps.instruction: For quantification, inject a calibration standard containing 2.5 pmol 2AA‑labelled chitotriose with each sample set.
